purpose: Performs single-fixture, base-30 calibration sweeps for the annotator pipeline. Defines routing rules for parameters to configuration objects, builds and runs parameter grids for boundary and contact detection, scores candidates against ground-truth data, and produces calibration verdict files.

public_api.name: CandidateSpec
public_api.role: Dataclass representing a serializable candidate configuration with base-30 overrides and strategy choices. Used to express parameter combinations for testing.

public_api.name: build_boundary_grid
public_api.role: Builds the 3,000-cell pinned boundary parameter grid as CandidateSpecs. Called to generate all combinations of boundary detection parameters (rest_speed, rest_window, etc.) for evaluation.

public_api.name: build_contact_grid
public_api.role: Builds the 108-cell pinned contact parameter grid with boundary parameters frozen. Called after selecting best boundary parameters to optimize contact detection settings.

public_api.name: shipped_spec
public_api.role: Returns the unmodified default configuration reference row. Called to include the shipped baseline in sweep comparisons.

public_api.name: serialise_spec
public_api.role: Serializes a CandidateSpec to a JSON-ready dictionary using the same routing validation as application. Called to convert internal spec representation to persistent form.

public_api.name: production_candidate_runner
public_api.role: Runs and scores one candidate configuration against fixture ground truth. Called by the executor pool as the main worker function for each parameter combination.

public_api.name: run_sweep
public_api.role: Executes the requested calibration phases (boundary, contact, or both) and writes results. Called as the main driver to perform a complete calibration sweep.

public_api.name: load_boundary_winner
public_api.role: Loads the boundary specification from a previous sweep's winner file. Called in contact-only phase runs to load frozen boundary parameters.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: Command-line entry point parsing arguments and invoking run_sweep. Called when the module is executed as a script.
